does: Builds one keyword condition of a dialogue's script from a parsed sentence: a switch over the keyword kind creates the KeywordCondition and its parameters through LSDialogs::KeywordParseCallback::CreateKwConditionParameter.

evidence.says: takes a KeywordParseCallback, a TParseSentence and the keyword index, switches over it and calls CreateKwConditionParameter from 35 places with the sentence's words

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a dialogue was on (segment 35 only), 141 times from 1 place, the script-line parser at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x395FEE0
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes

questions.ask: which dialogue's conditions were parsed in segment 35; a probe on it while starting a dialogue with a scripted condition would tie it to the dialogue load
